# Brandon Davenport

> Tech evangelist who ships: AI and data tooling at Hgraph, elected member of the Hiero Technical Steering Committee, and creator of the Hashgraph Enthusiasts Show.

Brandon Davenport works both sides of technology and audience: architecting systems with engineers, then presenting on stage, on camera, and on the timeline to build interest and adoption around them.

## Work

- [Hgraph](https://hgraph.com): led the AI and data tooling, including a [Model Context Protocol server and an AI data agent](https://docs.hgraph.com/mcp-server/setup-chatgpt) that surface Hedera Stats' ecosystem metrics through natural-language query.
- [Hgraph's 2026 platform recap](https://hgraph.com/blog/hgraph-in-2026-the-full-stack-onchain-data-platform): most recently authored piece.
- [Hiero Technical Steering Committee](https://hiero.org/tsc): elected member, under the Linux Foundation.

## Media

- [HederaCon 2025's wallet refresh talk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FTXUdQ6dTf8): moderated panel.
- [Hashgraph Enthusiasts Show](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CpjLibi4jp4): created and hosted for three years, 146 episodes interviewing founders and engineers across the ecosystem.
